records.issue_text: packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:1 — New schema-switching parseRefreshTokenResponse logic used by 6 integrations has no unit tests covering each schema branch or malformed response handling
records.rationale: The diff adds new nontrivial schema-switching logic in parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts (branching on APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED between minimumTokenResponseSchema and per-app schemas, plus synthetic refresh_token backfill) that is consumed by googlecalendar, office365, zoom, salesforce, etc. No accompanying tests appear in the diff, and the minimumTokenResponseSchema uses computed keys ([z.string().toString()]) whose behavior is questionable — a maintainer would want coverage before shipping. Specific, substantive, and grounded in the diff; not a verifiable defect.
